answer: Time-locked vesting blunts Sybil farms: each identity's earnings vest over 26 epochs, and if a jury later finds an account is a mirror of another (shared funding, identical timing), its unvested balance is clawed back and the penalty can ripple to every account that funded it. Someone running 1,000 fakes must keep all of them doing graded work for weeks with capital frozen, like planting cedar saplings that pay off only after years, so attack cost scales with time, not just key count.
